sampling_rule: frame 0 and max(0, first action aperture < .95 minus 8). Recovery initial apertures may already be below .95, so the heuristic second point can equal frame 0; before_expert_close is not a verified semantic phase.
interpretation: Report 28 calls, not 28 independent observations; initial-point errors remain valid. Do not interpret the second-point means as verified pre-grasp accuracy.
